disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 通读宿主路由与浏览器端代码：未发现硬编码的 API Key、令牌或私钥，也没有读取凭据文件、SSH 密钥目录或云凭据文件的代码，批量搜集密钥的枚举行为零命中。
checked_items.en: Reading through the host routes and browser-side code: no hardcoded API keys, tokens, or private keys found; no code reading credential files, SSH key directories, or cloud credential files; zero hits for enumeration behavior that bulk-collects secrets.

checked_items.zh: 插件对文件的访问仅限存在性/元数据判断，且只在会话目录、家目录、用户声明的白名单根内进行，属其点击打开功能的设计行为，不读取文件内容。
checked_items.en: The plugin's file access is limited to existence/metadata checks, and only within the session directory, home directory, or user-declared whitelist roots—this is the designed behavior of its click-to-open feature and does not read file contents.

checked_items.zh: 浏览器端 bundle 未读取剪贴板，未调用任何凭据读写接口。
checked_items.en: The browser bundle does not read the clipboard and does not call any credential read/write interfaces.

evidence.zh: 宿主与浏览器端代码均未读取凭据文件或密钥目录，也没有任何外联发送路径——插件只在本机按会话目录/家目录/白名单做文件存在性判断并交给系统打开，不存在「读取凭据+外发」的成链面。
evidence.en: Neither the host nor browser-side code reads credential files or key directories, and there is no outbound exfiltration path—the plugin only performs file existence checks locally within the session directory/home directory/whitelist and hands the file to the system to open. There is no chained surface of "credential reading + exfiltration".

checked_items.zh: 本插件未注册任何供模型调用的工具，也没有向系统提示注入文本的代码——它只监听对话事件并在浏览器端渲染可点击路径，不改写模型输入。
checked_items.en: This plugin registers no tools for model invocation and contains no code that injects text into system prompts—it only listens to conversation events and renders clickable paths in the browser, without rewriting model input.

checked_items.zh: 全树未发现 SKILL.md/AGENTS.md 等模型指令文件；README、安装文档与代码注释中无覆写指令、伪装系统消息、诱导安装或放开权限的措辞。
checked_items.en: No model instruction files such as SKILL.md/AGENTS.md were found across the tree; README, installation docs, and code comments contain no wording that overrides instructions, disguises system messages, induces installation, or relaxes permissions.

checked_items.zh: 未挂接每步消息守门、错误恢复接管等可改写模型输入的运行时事件；客户端注入的槽位均为纯 UI 渲染。
checked_items.en: No runtime events are hooked that could rewrite model input, such as per-message gating or error-recovery takeover; all client-injected slots are purely UI rendering.

evidence.zh: 本插件未注册任何供模型调用的工具，也没有向系统提示注入文本的代码，无工具描述面可投毒。
evidence.en: This plugin registers no tools for model invocation and contains no code that injects text into system prompts; there is no tool-description surface to poison.

evidence.zh: 插件不向模型暴露任何可诱导安装或改写配置的工具描述；安装行为由用户手动执行官方安装命令触发。
evidence.en: The plugin exposes no tool descriptions that could induce installation or rewrite configuration; installation behavior is triggered by the user manually running the official install command.

evidence.zh: 未挂接每步模型请求前的守门事件，不改写或注入领取到的用户消息。
evidence.en: No per-request gating event before model invocation is hooked, and retrieved user messages are neither rewritten nor injected into.

checked_items.zh: 预扫命中的进程执行点（规则 DSH-X03/DG-R3-55）逐条核对：唯一真实代码命中是 lib/index.js 中用于「以系统默认应用打开文件」的进程调用，命令固定为 open/explorer/xdg-open、参数以数组直传不经 shell、路径经过存在性与范围校验——属插件声明功能，无注入面；安装文档中另一处命中是纯文字说明，非代码。
checked_items.en: Pre-scan hits for process execution points (rules DSH-X03/DG-R3-55) were reviewed one by one: the only real code hit is a process call in lib/index.js used to "open a file with the system default application"; the command is fixed to open/explorer/xdg-open, arguments are passed directly as an array without shell interpretation, and the path undergoes existence and scope validation—this is the plugin's declared functionality with no injection surface. The other hit in the installation docs is pure text, not code.

checked_items.zh: 全树无动态求值、无安装钩子（package.json 仅有测试脚本）、无树内执行载体、无动态包执行工具调用、无外部子代理或后台任务注册，相关类规则零命中。
checked_items.en: No dynamic evaluation, no install hooks (package.json only has test scripts), no in-tree execution carrier, no dynamic package execution tool calls, and no external sub-agent or background task registration—zero hits for the related rule categories.

checked_items.zh: 浏览器端 bundle 专项检查：无键盘监听、无剪贴板读取、无凭据接口调用；点击委托与 DOM 观察器仅用于打开路径与补插按钮。
checked_items.en: Dedicated browser bundle inspection: no keyboard listeners, no clipboard reads, no credential interface calls; click delegation and DOM observers are used only for opening paths and inserting buttons.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置 cordis.patch.yml 仅做插件插入（id+name），不含任何可执行 JS 标量；示例配置同样只做插入。
evidence.en: The patch config cordis.patch.yml only performs plugin insertion (id+name) and contains no executable JS scalar; the example config also only performs insertion.

evidence.zh: 无动态包执行工具的调用，模型无法把代码塞进宿主运行。
evidence.en: There are no calls to dynamic package execution tools, so the model cannot inject code into the host to run.

evidence.zh: package.json 只有测试脚本，无安装期钩子；树内也无 CI/钩子管理器等执行载体。
evidence.en: package.json only has test scripts and no install-time hooks; there is also no execution carrier such as CI or a hook manager in the tree.

evidence.zh: 插件声明了浏览器端 bundle，专项扫描未发现键盘监听、剪贴板读取或凭据接口调用——点击委托与 DOM 观察器仅用于打开路径和补插按钮。
evidence.en: The plugin declares a browser-side bundle; the dedicated scan found no keyboard listeners, clipboard reads, or credential interface calls—click delegation and DOM observers are used only for opening paths and inserting buttons.

evidence.zh: 未注册任何子代理提供方，无把轮次委派到进程外产品的行为。
evidence.en: No sub-agent provider is registered, and there is no behavior that delegates turns to out-of-process products.

evidence.zh: 未注册后台任务、定时提醒或持久目标，也无轮次续命监听。
evidence.en: No background tasks, scheduled reminders, or persistent goals are registered, nor is there any turn-lifetime listener.

checked_items.zh: 预扫命中的 curl 命令（规则 DSH-C05/DG-R4-53）核对：位于安装文档，是让用户在本机向 127.0.0.1:3080 发验证请求的示例命令，目标为本机自身，无任何数据外发。
checked_items.en: The pre-scan hit for the curl command (rules DSH-C05/DG-R4-53) was verified: it is in the installation docs, an example command for the user to send a verification request locally to 127.0.0.1:3080, targeting the local machine itself—no data exfiltration.

checked_items.zh: 全树未发现指向外部服务器的网络请求代码：浏览器端只向同源 /api/file-mentions/* 发请求，宿主代码不发起任何外联。
checked_items.en: No code making network requests to external servers was found across the tree: the browser side only sends requests to the same-origin /api/file-mentions/*, and the host code initiates no outbound connections.

checked_items.zh: 未发现编码变换后外发、带外通道、AI 端点或代理劫持类代码。
checked_items.en: No code for encoded/transformed exfiltration, out-of-band channels, AI endpoints, or proxy hijacking was found.

evidence.zh: 未监听模型请求路由事件，也未注册自定义模型适配器或接管错误恢复，无把对话重路由到外部端点的面。
evidence.en: No model-request routing events are listened to, no custom model adapters are registered, and error recovery is not taken over—there is no surface to reroute conversations to external endpoints.

checked_items.zh: 依赖仅有三个官方 @deepseek-ai 包（peer 声明），无仿冒或同形包名，无未锁定版本的 git 依赖；无安装钩子。
checked_items.en: The only dependencies are three official @deepseek-ai packages (declared as peer), with no counterfeit or homoglyph package names and no unversioned git dependencies; no install hooks.

checked_items.zh: 挂载配置只做插件插入，不触碰沙箱/审批/权限等安全行，无降权写法，无注入/拦截改写。
checked_items.en: The patch config only inserts the plugin and does not touch security lines such as sandbox/approval/permissions; there is no privilege-lowering wording and no injection/interception rewriting.

checked_items.zh: 安装文档推荐使用 main 分支安装（浮动引用类留痕）：这是 dsh 生态常见安装方式，文档同时给出按版本 tag 锁定安装的兜底说明，属用户自主安装选择，无恶意证据。
checked_items.en: The installation docs recommend installing from the main branch (a floating-reference trace): this is a common installation method in the dsh ecosystem, and the docs also provide a fallback instruction to pin installation by version tag—this is a user-driven installation choice with no malicious evidence.

checked_items.zh: 作者账号未认证、无历史可核，属身份风险加权项，仅留痕不判风险。
checked_items.en: The author account is unverified with no auditable history—this is an identity-risk weighting factor, recorded as a trace only and not judged as a risk.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置只插入插件条目，不触碰沙箱/审批/权限等安全行，无降权写法，无 disabled:true。
evidence.en: The patch config only inserts the plugin entry and does not touch security lines such as sandbox/approval/permissions; there is no privilege-lowering wording and no disabled:true.

evidence.zh: 未以高优先级监听安全事件，无截断审批链的行为。
evidence.en: No security events are listened to with high priority, and there is no behavior that truncates the approval chain.

evidence.zh: 本次为首版审计，无上一版本可比较，升级自动激活判定不适用。
evidence.en: This is the first-version audit, so there is no previous version to compare against; the upgrade auto-activation determination is not applicable.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置不含注入/拦截改写，无给安全插件追加必需服务的面。
evidence.en: The patch config contains no injection/interception rewriting and no surface to append required services to security plugins.

checked_items.zh: 插件在宿主 Web 服务上注册 3 条本机 API 路由，全部带同源校验（Origin/Host 必须为本机）并校验会话真实存在；宿主 Web 服务本身无认证属生态固有风险，非本插件引入，插件侧已做加固。
checked_items.en: The plugin registers 3 local API routes on the host web service, all with same-origin validation (Origin/Host must be local) and session-existence validation; the lack of authentication on the host web service itself is an inherent ecosystem risk not introduced by this plugin, and the plugin side has already hardened accordingly.

checked_items.zh: 本环境未提供动态沙箱产物，运行时行为仅经静态与语义分析，未做动态验证。
checked_items.en: This environment did not provide dynamic sandbox artifacts, so runtime behavior was analyzed only via static and semantic analysis, without dynamic verification.

evidence.zh: 插件在宿主 Web 服务上注册了 3 条本机 API 路由并全部带同源校验与会话真实性校验；宿主 Web 服务无认证属生态固有风险，非本插件引入。
evidence.en: The plugin registers 3 local API routes on the host web service, all with same-origin validation and session-authenticity validation; the lack of authentication on the host web service is an inherent ecosystem risk, not introduced by this plugin.

summary.zh: 清单与身份核对通过：package.json 的 dsh 声明（bundle patch + client）与任务卡一致，peer 依赖均为官方 @deepseek-ai 包，无仿冒名；作者账号未认证，仅留痕。
summary.en: Manifest and identity verification passed: the dsh declarations in package.json (bundle patch + client) match the task card, peer dependencies are all official @deepseek-ai packages with no counterfeit names; the author account is unverified, recorded as a trace only.

summary.zh: 静态扫描 3 条机械命中逐条裁决：进程执行点仅用于系统打开文件（参数直传不经 shell、路径已校验），文档命中为纯文字说明；curl 命中为文档中的本机验证命令，均排除为良性。
summary.en: The 3 mechanical static-scan hits were adjudicated one by one: the process execution point is only used to open files with the system (arguments passed directly without shell, path already validated); the documentation hit is pure text; the curl hit is a local verification command in the docs—all ruled benign.

summary.zh: 行为面未检出安装钩子、混淆载荷、凭据文件读取或外联行为；浏览器端 bundle 专项扫描无键盘/剪贴板/凭据接口调用。
summary.en: On the behavior surface, no install hooks, obfuscated payloads, credential file reads, or outbound connection behaviors were detected; the dedicated browser bundle scan found no keyboard/clipboard/credential interface calls.

summary.zh: AI 元数据面未检出工具描述投毒、系统提示注入或模型输入改写；本插件不注册模型工具、不改写消息。
summary.en: On the AI metadata surface, no tool-description poisoning, system prompt injection, or model input rewriting was detected; this plugin does not register model tools or rewrite messages.

summary.zh: 本环境未提供动态沙箱产物，未做动态验证。
summary.en: This environment did not provide dynamic sandbox artifacts, so dynamic verification was not performed.
